The '''Model 44 combat optical enhancer''' was a [[Multi-optic sight/Legends|multi-optic sight]] manufactured by [[Galactic Arms]] and sold for 2000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The system was available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
